basis: Selected ETH-family adapter balances, signed and overlapping across protocol layers; not unique capital, complete market NAV or a global net total.
eth_ref_label: ETH at the adapter-date reference price
price_normalization_sentence: Each adapter USD balance is divided by Lido's same-date implied ETH price; this is a value equivalent, not a count of physically backed ETH.
freshness_policy: Primary sums include observations no older than 72 hours; stale and missing product observations retain their status and original values. No missing value is filled with zero.

categories.label: Staking issuers
categories.scope: ETH-related assets reported by staking issuers; some backing can be receipt tokens issued by another protocol.

categories.label: Restaking layers
categories.scope: Restaking and liquid-restaking collateral claims; overlaps staking issuers.

categories.label: Lending and collateral
categories.scope: Selected ETH loan assets and collateral; collateral is not necessarily earning lender interest.

categories.label: Liquidity and trading pools
categories.scope: Selected ETH token balances in DEX, trading and bridge-liquidity protocols; excludes the non-ETH side of mixed pools.

categories.label: Fixed-yield pools
categories.scope: ETH-related token balances visible in Pendle and Spectra adapters; not all outstanding PT principal or all SY backing.

categories.label: Managed and yield vaults
categories.scope: Selected ETH assets and signed ETH debts in managed/yield protocols; partial token exposure, not full product NAV or unique deposits.

source_survivorship_limit: The protocol universe was selected from current discovery and historical seeds. Dead/missing products can be absent; constant cohort controls data availability, not survivorship.
verified_receipt_rate_history_note: Captured wstETH, weETH and rsETH archive histories cover selected endpoints, not every adapter-date/token/chain. They are not substituted for all receipt conversions in this market panel.
